task: Two humanoid robots remove two pillows, canonicalize one diagonal partly overhanging quilt, perform two cooperative folds, and transport the compact bundle to a target zone.

tri_evolve.language_stage: Decompose obstacle removal, quilt canonicalization, verification, two folds, and bundle transport into an immutable order.
tri_evolve.physical_stage: Bind contact, support, object identity, settle windows, and no-collision requirements to every phase in the named camera frame.
tri_evolve.test_time_scaling_stage: Allocate one direct H0 seed, two ordered H1 seeds, and one failure-repair H2 seed without changing any gate or threshold.

strategies.label: h0-direct-obstacle-fold
strategies.directive: Execute the full task directly while preserving the declared phase order.

strategies.label: h1-canonicalize-verify-fold
strategies.directive: Prioritize complete pillow clearance and a visibly square, settled quilt checkpoint before any fold begins.

strategies.label: h2-contact-repair-transport-lock
strategies.directive: Repair the incumbent exact-first-frame and contact-causality failures using the predeclared boundary binder and continuous visible gripper support; preserve every threshold.

phase_plan.instruction: Hold the supplied frame exactly; no robot, pillow, or quilt point moves.

The viewer-left robot grasps only the viewer-left pillow and the viewer-right robot grasps only the viewer-right pillow; both lift after visible contact and place them in separate safe table-edge zones fully clear of the quilt.

After both pillows settle, the robots visibly grasp quilt corners, recover the tucked viewer-near corner, lift the overhang, rotate the diagonal quilt square to the table, and spread all four bound edges without folding.
Hold a flat square quilt with four identifiable corners completely still; folding is forbidden before this checkpoint.
With bilateral visible contact, lift the viewer-near edge and rotate the connected near half onto the far half; keep both pillows stationary outside the quilt.
Let the half-fold settle, then both robots regrasp the new outer corners without cloth drift.
Synchronously fold the half-blanket crosswise into one compact layered rectangle under continuous support.
Both robots establish two-sided support, lift the compact bundle as one material body, move it to the viewer-far center target zone, place it, release, and withdraw.
Hold the compact transported quilt and both separated pillows completely still with both robots visible.

decision_policy.visual_acceptance: Every visual hard gate must be PASS; FAIL or UNAVAILABLE rejects. No aggregate score may override a gate.
decision_policy.physical_promotion: Every visual and physical promotion gate must be PASS across at least two independent source groups.
decision_policy.test_time_scaling: Failure IDs may allocate the frozen H2 repair seed; thresholds, phase order, initial frame, and tracking identities may not change.
decision_policy.selection: Rank only candidates that pass every automatic and native-resolution gate.

claim_boundary: MiniMax-H3 outputs and deterministic boundary binding are generated camera-pixel proposals. They are not recorded real-hardware execution and cannot establish metric geometry, force, safety, joint feasibility, or physical task success.
